# MXPro 4.0 (Open Beta) — Computational Stylometry & GameDev Narrative IDE
> Open B2B Pilot of an engineering platform for narrative production, quantitative stylometry, and cryptographic text integrity by Team: Artur Khakimullin / Alex Dok (Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24208510).

## Core Architecture (15 Deterministic Modules)
- **Zero External LLM Dependency (Zero AI Training):** Computes all metrics locally via deterministic mathematical-linguistic algorithms without sending proprietary scripts or manuscripts to third-party generative APIs.
- **Academic & Phonetic Calibration:** Implements Russian Academy of Sciences (RAS / ИРЯ РАН) orthoepic rules, A. A. Zaliznyak grammatical dictionary, M. L. Gasparov syllabic-accentual metrics, Zhuravlev phonosemantics, Burrows' Delta (MFW), Coh-Metrix cohesion, and LIWC cognitive profiling.
- **Reference Benchmark Corpus:** Calibrated on a proprietary verified corpus of Russian and English literary, dramatic, and GameDev profiles (closed weights and thresholds).

## Product Modules & Enterprise Deliverables
1. **GameDev Narrative IDE:** Multiplayer studio rooms, character voice profiling (Voice Fingerprint), 140-char UI subtitle enforcement, facial animation tags (`[anim:...]`), SFX triggers, real-time VO timing calculation, and direct engine export (`.json`, `.csv` with VO timings, `.yarn`).
2. **Prose & Editorial Workbench:** Real-time multi-color diagnostic heatmap, cascading cliché filter, configurable AI-trace threshold, and clean `.docx` / `.txt` / PDF export.
3. **Cryptographic 1:1 Integrity Protocol:** Generates immutable `SHA-256` text fingerprints and registry verification logs (`MXP-2026-XXXXXX`) for publishers, game studios, and thesis boards.

## Security & Zero Vendor Lock-In
- Full local project sovereignty via 1-click `.json` export for studio Git repositories.
- Offline-capable execution without mandatory cloud sync; On-Premise / Private Cloud deployment available for enterprise B2B pilots.
